items.text: COMMITTEE DISCHARGED AND COMMITTED TO RULES
ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.815

items.actClause:
AN ACT in relation to authorizing the city of Little Falls, in the county of
Herkimer, to finance certain deficits by the issuance of bonds
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S7028

SPONSOR: WALCZYK
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act in relation to authorizing the city of Little Falls, in the coun-
ty of Herkimer, to finance certain deficits by the issuance of bonds

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

This bill authorizes the city of Little Falls to finance deficits via
bonds.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS: Section 1: Names the bill.

Section 2: Authorizes the city of Little Falls to issue up to $3.4
million in serial bonds on or before October 1, 2026.

Section 3: Establishes that the Comptroller must review the necessity of
bonds prior to their issuance. The bill also requires the city to submit
a report to the chairs of the Senate Finance Committee and Assembly Ways
and Means Committee.

Section 4: Sets out terms for bonds.

Section 5: Requires the city of Little Falls to produce quarterly
reports on expenditures and ledger accounts. Also requires the mayor to
put together a three year financial plan, with oversight from the Comp-
troller's office

Section 6: Establishes a severability clause. Section 7: Sets the effec-
tive date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The city of Little Falls is in dire financial straits due to fiscal
mismanagement. This bill would allow the city to authorize $3.4 million
in bonds to set Little Falls on a better financial path. The city has
requested this piece of home rule legislation.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS:

None to the state; $3.4 million in bonds for the city of Little Falls.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This Act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Authorizes the city of Little Falls, in the county of Herkimer, to issue serial bonds in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed three million four hundred thousand dollars for the purpose of liquidating deficits in its general, golf, and water funds; requires that the city of Little Falls prepare quarterly budget reports, quarterly trial balances and a three-year financial plan.
title: Enacts the "city of Little Falls deficit financing act" authorizing the city of Little Falls, in the county of Herkimer, to finance certain deficits by the issuance of bonds
